terminologyRules: Feline asthma is chronic inflammatory lower-airway disease with hyperreactivity and reversible bronchoconstriction, not a synonym for any cough or bronchial image.
There is no single accepted clinical gold-standard test; diagnosis integrates compatible disease and explicit exclusions.
Asthma, chronic bronchitis, lungworm, heartworm-associated respiratory disease, pneumonia, edema, neoplasia, pleural disease and foreign body remain distinct states.
Blood or airway eosinophilia is not specific for asthma and never bypasses regional parasite and heartworm assessment.
Breed, one symptom, one image or response to an unreviewed trial never confirms asthma alone.
Minimal handling and oxygen precede radiography, BAL or bronchoscopy in unstable cats.
A quiet chest in an exhausted cat can represent critically poor airflow rather than improvement.
Rescue-only use is not complete chronic inflammatory control.
Device prescription is incomplete until mask/spacer technique and owner-cat feasibility are observed.
Episode history, oxygenation, imaging, sample truth, environment and response are authored before player choice and persist through reload.
Drug, dose, taper, actuation count, oxygen target and emergency airway/procedure technique require separately approved protocols.

variants.title: Стабильное подозрение на астму кошек
variants.diagnosticTruth: Stable cat has compatible lower-airway disease with explicit regional, infectious, cardiac and structural exclusions; no single test is treated as definitive.

presentations.complaint: Intermittent cough/wheeze with normal breathing between episodes and no hypoxemia.

investigations.result: Compatible or nonspecific with mimic screen.

outcomes.safe: Mild lower-airway disease is investigated and monitored proportionately.
outcomes.unsafe: One cough, breed or response creates asthma.

ownerCommunication: Explain why mild episodic signs still need a structured diagnosis and control log.

presentations.complaint: Repeated cough with compatible bronchial/hyperinflation pattern, stable enough for staged workup.

followUp.timing: sampling/exclusion result and same-scale control review

outcomes.safe: Asthma and chronic bronchitis remain differentiated by integrated evidence.
outcomes.unsafe: Bronchial image or eosinophils alone decide.

ownerCommunication: Explain why similar images occur with several lower-airway diseases.

presentations.complaint: Owner reports hairball/nausea; video shows neck-extended cough or remains ambiguous.

examFindings.finding: Video and respiratory/GI facts remain separate.

outcomes.safe: The event is classified respectfully and data are preserved.
outcomes.unsafe: Hairball label delays respiratory care or GI history disappears.

ownerCommunication: Ask for video and describe observable differences without ridicule.

variants.title: Острое обострение астмы
variants.diagnosticTruth: Known or suspected lower-airway disease acutely worsens but responds to initial stabilization and remains below severe-status criteria; trigger, technique, use and mimics are audited.

presentations.complaint: Compatible smoke/dust/aerosol/litter/renovation exposure precedes increased cough or expiratory effort.

examFindings.finding: Removal is feasible therapeutic test, not certainty.

followUp.timing: early effort/oxygen check and environment-response review

outcomes.safe: Modifiable irritant is reduced while severity is monitored.
outcomes.unsafe: Correlation creates an unreviewed allergen diagnosis.

ownerCommunication: Name the specific exposure and feasible change without blame or cure promise.

presentations.complaint: Prescribed inhaled plan is not reaching the cat because seal, timing, breaths or conditioning is inadequate.

examFindings.finding: Owner/cat are not punished for impossible delivery.

followUp.timing: early repeat demonstration and control log

outcomes.safe: Delivery barrier is corrected or a feasible route reviewed.
outcomes.unsafe: Device prescription is assumed successful or owner blamed.

ownerCommunication: Demonstrate, observe return demonstration and document one feasible next step.

presentations.complaint: Attacks recur despite apparently adequate technique and reported controller use.

followUp.timing: prompt control audit and revised versioned checkpoint

outcomes.safe: Poor control is explained before reviewed plan revision.
outcomes.unsafe: Rescue-only use is accepted or code changes dose.

ownerCommunication: Explain that frequent rescue use signals inadequate long-term control, not personal failure.

variants.title: Тяжёлый бронхоспазм или астматический статус
variants.diagnosticTruth: Bronchospasm and airway inflammation threaten oxygenation or ventilatory endurance; emergency stabilization precedes complete diagnosis while acute mimics/complications remain visible.

presentations.complaint: Open-mouth breathing, pronounced expiratory push, cyanosis or reliable hypoxemia.

outcomes.safe: Gas exchange is protected before complete diagnostics.

ownerCommunication: State briefly that breathing support and low-stress transfer are immediate priorities.

presentations.complaint: Air movement decreases, chest becomes quiet, fatigue/mental change or gas exchange worsens.

examFindings.finding: Reduced sound reflects poor air movement.

outcomes.unsafe: Quiet lungs are charted normal or transfer is delayed.

ownerCommunication: Explain that quieter breathing can mean exhaustion, not recovery.

presentations.complaint: Sudden worsening, asymmetric/absent sounds or poor response raises pneumothorax/pleural complication.

examFindings.finding: Not all distress is assigned to asthma.

outcomes.safe: Acute complication is identified in the same episode.
outcomes.unsafe: More rescue-only treatment delays pleural care or technique is invented.

ownerCommunication: Explain sudden complication and immediate external procedure/ICU need.

variants.title: Имитация астмы или плохой контроль
variants.diagnosticTruth: Competing disease explains all or part of signs, or control is poor because diagnosis, environment, device or reviewed plan is incomplete.

presentations.complaint: Outdoor/region/travel and compatible findings raise lungworm or heartworm-associated respiratory disease.

outcomes.safe: Overlapping disease is separated with epidemiologic eligibility.
outcomes.unsafe: Eosinophils prove asthma or random parasites appear.

ownerCommunication: Explain why geography and exposure change which tests are meaningful.

presentations.complaint: Neutrophilic/mixed airway findings, culture or chronic mucus pattern suggest bronchitis, infection or mixed disease.

investigations.result: Inflammatory proportions, bacteria and sample quality.

outcomes.safe: Mixed inflammation remains explicit and treatment evidence-aligned.
outcomes.unsafe: Neutrophils prescribe antimicrobials or everything is called asthma.

ownerCommunication: Explain that more than one airway process can coexist.

presentations.complaint: Imaging/exam suggests edema, cardiac disease, mass, focal airway lesion, pleural disease or foreign body.

examFindings.finding: Pleural, cardiac, pneumonia and structure stay visible.

outcomes.safe: Dangerous mimic is diagnosed and transferred without data loss.
outcomes.unsafe: Respiratory distress is forced into asthma and immunosuppression proceeds blindly.

ownerCommunication: Explain which alternative is dangerous and how the next test separates it.

familyValidationRules: Reject if oxygen and minimal handling are delayed for complete diagnostics in a dyspneic cat.
Reject if a quiet chest in an exhausted cat is recorded as normal or improving.
Reject if breed, eosinophilia, one radiograph or bronchodilator response alone confirms asthma.
Reject if lungworm or heartworm content appears without compatible region and exposure.
Reject if neutrophils alone generate an antimicrobial indication or all lower-airway disease is collapsed into asthma.
Reject if the generator creates a drug, dose, emergency procedure, device prescription or ventilation setting.
